name: @workspec/parity
description: C4 visual-parity harness (S4, #120): fixed fixtures rendered through the recomposed @workspec/c4-ui + canvas engine, screenshot-goldened per scenario in light and dark. Separate from apps/mf-host on purpose — the MF smoke's failure domain is federation/singleton-React, this one's is pixels; coupling them would make both slower and flakier.

scripts.parity: pnpm run build:deps && vite build && playwright test
scripts.parity:update: pnpm run build:deps && vite build && playwright test --update-snapshots
